title: Waterlint usage
summary: How to validate Waterloo docstrings and inspect problems.

items: Use validate after editing a docstring to check for errors and inconsistencies.
Use explain-section to learn what belongs in a section.
Use explain-subsection to learn what belongs in a subsection.
Use coverage only for whole modules that are already mostly consistent and documented.
Use --basedir to point waterlint at the module search path.
Use --obj to target the exact object.
Use --profile to select the docstring profile for explain commands.
The supported profiles are module, class, function, method, and inherited_method.
